notes.title: From GameCrafterTeam: Thank you everyone for supporting Project Nimbus
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Pawee30948 from GameCrafterTeam here.

Finally, Project Nimbus Complete Edition, which is the Unreal Engine 4 remastered edition is now online on Steam as a free update for everyone. I hope you guys enjoy it!

Shibuya-san and Kai-san, GameTomo’s developers work very hard to ship you this complete edition that runs so smooth on both GPU and CPU aspect. Ladies and gentlemen, give them a round of applause for shipping this polished edition of the game we are all proud of.

It has been 5 years since we’ve released the game on Steam as early access in 2014 and the game has been continually updated since then. If we would go all the way back to when the development started in December 2012 though, if it’s a human baby, that kid would be in grade school now.

We shall be sticking on working on games in Project Nimbus series for quite a long time. There’s a sequel in production as we speak. Hopefully, we’ll get to see this child mature all the way to high school through adulthood someday together with you guys. By then I would’ve been a middle-aged man already though. Haha. I wonder if by then, how many Project Nimbus would be released. Maybe it would be possible to have an anime series someday.

With lessons learned from the original Project Nimbus, we’ve found several points we wanted to improve upon in the sequel and implement systems that will reward player more for their skills so it would feel more engaging. And this is the first time that we do the teenager boy and girl meeting and adventuring together in the world of giant robots. Well, I have this dream of making this kind of story since I was in high school. It’d be nice if we can do it well. We’re looking forward to the day that we can present you the trailer.

Thank you, everyone, for your support for Project Nimbus.
Pawee30948

notes.title: [Hot Fix] Soryu Kai patch is out
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
You might notice that there's an update of Project Nimbus coming out today.

This is just a hotfix of the update I released yesterday. I received some bug reports that the moving up keyboard input doesn't work after the player has done some keyboard mapping adjustment so I've taken a look.

It appears that the bug just simply caused by a typo referencing to moving up input in the source code. To explain it simply, I mistype it as 'MoveUp' instead of 'GoUp' in the key setting section while the rest of the source code that use 'GoUp'. Look like this bug was there for a while but we've not detected that until yesterday. Thank you for reporting this in!

Gentlemen, this is why you shall not do the coding when you need to sleep. One typo in the >120,000 lines of code and the game is broken.

I'm glad we've fixed this.
Pawee

notes.title: New update: Your playing progress is saved
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the new build codename [b]'Soryu' [/b]is now online.

What's the big thing about this update? The game now saves your playing progress. You can continue playing from the part you left last time by simply pressing the 'continue' button.

I choose to do this the same way as online streaming websites. We save your playing progress. But you are still able to access any missions you want from the missions select menu. I don't know if I can explain my idea very well, I believe you guys shall be able to access any part of the game you want the same way that you can do it with movies since you've brought it. You own all of that.

And we prevent you from being spoiled (if you don't want) by having a very convenient way to start a new game or continue your playing progress by simply pressing the 'continue' or 'new game' on the menu without having to enter the missions select menu.

Hope you guys like that.

There's another small thing that I've adjusted. I've removed the 'mouse cursor movement smoothing' things from the menu. So the cursor will move more sharply, more responsive to your control. I guess you guys like it more this way.

Oh, there's a new ace pilots boss squadron appearing in the later part of Mission 10.  Meet "Karma" squadron, lead by USAF's ace pilot Michael "Melwin" Lansfeld in his customized M5 Viper. They'll come to assist the Black Knight squadron fighting against you but only in the 'PREPARE TO DIE' (hard) difficulty.

That's it for today's update.
Thank you very much for playing Project Nimbus.
Pawee Pakamekanon

notes.title: "Akagi Kai" update, and development roadmap
notes.content:
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/akagikaiannounceart][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/AkagiKaiAnnounceArt.png[/img][/url]

Hello, everyone. Today a new update: code name "Akagi Kai" is out. So, here're the change list.

- Gripen and S47 Berkut have new cockpit.
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/s47-cockpit][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/UDK_2017-10-04_15-31-44-30.png[/img][/url]

- Fix the "game don't restart after mission fail" glitch in 'Thermopylae' mission.
- Make Mirai in Comatose mission (mission 16) doesn't have to stop moving too much often.
- Nerf Skull squadron health regeneration rate in the second part of Mission 18: Yamato Fortress. And we fine tuning the ending timer of that mission.
- Adjust game balance of the 'Against all Enemies' mission. Reinforcement come assist to make player less likely to fail the final fight of the first part of the mission.
- Graphic improvement in all Audio Log screens.
- We tried new graphic technique in Sacrificet Omnia (Mission 1) and Rise, Mirai (Mission 2), we hope this will make the level prettier. If you like the improvement, we're going to do this to all level.

It's first update since we exit Early Access right? Gameplay adjustment, a little bit improvement here and there, no new content yet.

So, what's to come in future updates? Here's our development roadmap.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/roadmap][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Roadmap.png[/img][/url]

.
And, yes, about CODE MIRAI. A lot of you guys were worrying about this. Here's formal announcement from GameCrafterTeam + GameTomo + KISS-ltd.

"Dear Project Nimbus Fans,

It has come to our attention that there are rumors and confusions regarding Project Nimbus for PS4 AKA Project Nimbus: Code Mirai. We would like to clarify this matter for you.

Project Nimbus : Code Mirai is being developed by our Japanese partner, GameTomo who has invested their monetary resource, time and technical expertise to make this version a reality. GamecrafterTeam is acting as a consultant and quality assurance to make sure that the PS4 version stays true to Project Nimbus experience as much as possible. 

The decision whether to port the PS4 version to PC or not is still being discussed at this point.  There are technical issues as well as the fact that Code: Mirai is a collaborative project so the decision is not up to us at Gamecrafter alone. We hope to come up with the best solution possible to please the gaming community. Project Nimbus cannot possibly have happened without your support. It is your game as much as it is ours and it will stay that way.  

Our dear supporters, please rest assured that all of your money has gone into the development of the PC version (and our instant noodles) as we have promised. We have dedicated our effort into finishing this game but having said that, Gamecrafterteam will continue to work on additional contents post release. Taking advantage of the upgradability of the PC platform, we have plans to add more features into Project Nimbus well into the future."
...
So, that's the joint annoucement from 3 companies: KISS-ltd, GameTomo and GameCrafterTeam
--------------------------

So in short, I'm speaking to you that
- All of the money from PC players shall and always be used for PC players only.
- We're working on improving the graphic of the game and we vow to make the PC version of Project Nimbus look the best and modern, like any game released in 2017 shall be.
- We're adding content to Project Nimbus and we have the development plan for that.

---

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/ingrid-bustshot-1][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Ingrid_Bustshot-1.png[/img][/url]

Thank you everyone for playing Project Nimbus.
Pawee
GameCrafterTeam

notes.title: A little bit about fanworks, especially fanmade game.
notes.content:
Hello,

In addition to our game’s [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/257030/announcements/detail/834663798970953047]fanwork policy[/url], I think it would be good if we made it more clear in the case of fan games (doujin games).

I’ll keep this short and informative:

1. If you don’t sell your fan game, you can do whatever you want to do. You have 100% freedom.

2. If you are going to sell your game just don’t use the extracted model files from Project Nimbus in your work.

3. Fan-made (doujin) game’s stories are non-canon.

4. Project Nimbus IP is ours. Your creation is yours. If anyone steals your work and says that it’s a fan-made thing tell them that the creator of Project Nimbus stands by your side. You have our permission to do fan-made games and art with your own creations.

We are very excited and glad that our work can inspire other creators. If you want to do fanworks of our game, we’re very glad and encouraging you to do this. It’s just if you want to make a commercial game, please don’t use model files extracted from Project Nimbus. If you make your own art and models in your fan-made game you can sell it.

Pawee

notes.title: Kirishima Kai update: Mostly about that enemy zoom window
notes.content:
Hello there pilots. We have a lot of game improvement in this update.


[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/kirishimakaiupdate21][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/UDK_2016-09-19_01-45-50-81.png[/img][/url]
- We've move the lock-on zoom windows to the left side of the screen. So it won't obstruct the view of actual enemy position and it shall be easier to see distance between you and the locked target.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/kirishimakaiupdate2][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/LODCompare.png[/img][/url]
- We also improve quality of the zoom windows image. No more blurry texture and lower resolution model glitch that is there since the inception of the lock on windows system. From now on, you can see the locked enemy in sharp texture and high resolution model. Look at the photo above, it's much prettier right?


[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/kirishimakaiupdate][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/UDK_2016-09-21_20-45-08-30.png[/img][/url]
- We've got some report that Mission 15 in easy difficulty, Andei is far too hard to be in the easy mode. Study from many let's play video on YouTube on easy difficulty, we found that most of times it's caused by player got hit with particle cannon. So, we make it more likely for player to have chance to evade his particle cannon.
- We also create graphic warning for Andei's particle cannon.

- We adjust mission 18 design to improve the game's performance. This mission shall be more enjoyable experience to play now. But I also want to hear from you guys as well.

- We adjust S-47 Berkut A.I.'s autoshotgun a little bit so the Berkuts will have less impact on game's performance and make them not so overpowered opponents. Make the fight more enjoyable.

Most of the change in this update are from community request. I even surprise at how it become more enjoyable experience to play for me as well after relatively small change is done..

So if there additional things you guys think we shall adjust in the game existing content or is there something that bug you that make the game not fun as it shall be, please tell us. I want this game to be up to your guy's expectation. I want this game to be fun.

We're working on Mission 19. Hope we can ship that mission shortly.

[i]The codename of this build is Kirishima Kai. Check on the main menu if you're not sure you're running the latest update of the game.[/i]

notes.title: Untitled
New update "Kirishima" ! Mission 18 - "Yamato Fortress" is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we haven't post update for quite some times right?

Today we have new patch, code name "Kirishima" containing Mission 18 and A LOT of game system's improvment.

Let's start with Mission 18: Yamato Fortress.

---

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release5][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/M18_release_banner.png[/img][/url]

Greetings, pilot! We are back again with a new mission for you.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release3][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Capture_4.PNG[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release8][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_003.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release6][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_001.png[/img][/url]

Yamato Fortress is CFN continental defense network located in Okinawa, an array of gigantic anti-air cannons more than capable of wiping any attacking fleet. Destorying it is a daunting if not impossible task for the UCN if they are to circumvent the final obstacle and drive the CFN off Pacific region.

But with Lt.Yuliana and her shiny new ZX-08 Budushcheye, they just might.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release11][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_cutscene_002.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release12][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_cutscene_003.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release13][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_cutscene_004.png[/img][/url]

In this build we also came around to include many audio logs for Mission 1 to 9. After you see this, we recommend you to check the older missions out and immerse yourself in Project Nimbus' universe. 

Several important gameplay changes have been made, most important of which is the removal of F.E.S. system. Now, you have to manually keep the target in your vision to stay locked on. We believe that by removing automated target tracking, the game will be more engaging and challenging for players. To compensate, gamepad users will have the rotation speed (on right analog stick by default) increased 3 times faster, allowing you to easily get the bead on faster enemies.

There is also a damage cap put into place, to prevent sudden death when your BattleFrame takes damage faster than the player can handle.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release1][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Capture_2.PNG[/img][/url]

We will conclude this news with a complete list of changes for this build. Like always, play the game and let us know what you think in Steam Discussion page or Facebook page! We are always all ears!

The codename for this update is "Kirishima". Check in the main menu to see if you're running latest version of the game.

----

Change list:
- Added MIssion 18 "Yamato Fortress"
- F.E.S. system is removed from the game. Gamepad users will have look sensitivity increased by three times to compensate.
- Added "Damage Delta" system; to prevent sudden death when player's BattleFrame takes damage faster than player can handle.
- Added low hull integrity (low hitpoints) warning, along with better damage feedback visual.
- AI-controlled IFV will now be destroyed if it hits water.
- M1 Guardian - Micromissile ammo capacity is increased from 2 to 3.
- Black Knights Squadron (Mission 10 - For the Fatherland) was nerfed to make the mission more playable.
- Mission 8 (Fragile Peace) has been adjusted; the downtime in between enemy waves has been reduced.
- Fixed audio errors in Mission 7 (Against All Enemy).
- Fixed errors with Multi-locker that occur when the game is hitting low FPS.
- Fixed Particle Cannon weapon not working properly on AI-controlled UCN Cruisers. They should be comparable to the CFN equivalent now.
- Fixed AI-controlled S47 Berkut not firing the Autoshotgun at hostile targets. The usage of their automatic shotgun was not as effective as it should be until now.
- Fixed text characters displaying as [] in subtitles.
- Fixed the bug where locked-on enemy shows up in mini-display with low texture resolution instead of defined settings.

notes.title: New update "Kongou"! Mission 15 – "Tenshi no Saigo" – is here!
notes.content:
Hello! We apologize for our late announcement, because during last night, Mission 15 “Tenshi no Saigo” just went live!

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission15-prime-art][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Previe1_RAW.png[/img][/url]

This update marks an important plot point in the storyline, and we took quite a long time to make it worthy of Act 2 ending. We're not going to put any spoiler here aside from the fact that one warship from our KickStarter backer will show up. It is a long mission, and we hope you will enjoy it.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission15-screenshot][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/M15_screencap_01.jpg[/img][/url]

First thing you will see is that we've changed the main menu! The one we have been using up to this point was a placeholder. (Right now there are even more BattleFrames that wasn't put on display inside the old hangar.) The rework has been a long time coming, and we thought this is a good opportunity to fix that.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission15-screenshot1][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/M15_screencap_02.jpg[/img][/url]

For those who have trouble with laser sword on GCTX-01 Mirai, we solved a certain bug that plagued the BattleFrame since we adjust Mirai's animation some time ago. Now it should register a hit more often. We're still on a lookout for any remaining issue regarding the laser sword. If you feel something was off, don't hesitate to send us your feedback.

Also, the Railgun on GCTX-01 now fire twice the rounds! This balance change we made should make Mirai as powerful as it should be.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission15-screenshot2][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/M15_screencap_03.jpg[/img][/url]

We would like to thank all players for the support you've given us in the passing years! As always, Feel free to voice your opinion in the game's Steam Discussion section or on our Facebook page. We will continue to develop and refine the game to be as good as possible. 

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission15-screenshot3][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/M15_screencap_04.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission15-screenshot4][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/M15_screencap_05.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission15-screenshot5][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/M15_screencap_06.jpg[/img][/url]

Sorry for our messy schedule. Enjoy the update, and see you in Act 3!

-- GameCrafterTeam staffs

[i] The codename of this update is "Kongou". Check in the main menu to see if you're running the latest version of the game. [/i]

Changelog
- Added Mission 15 - “Tenshi no Saigo”
- Changed background scene in main menu.
- Changes to GCTX-01 Mirai
    -- Fixed issue on Laser Sword to make it easier to register hits.
    -- Railgun now fire 2 rounds instead of 1 every time it fires. This however does not effect ammo capacity. (5 ammo will now fire 10 rounds)
- Fixed issue on UCN warships causing the game to freeze up.
- Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Mission 14 - "Bridge to Space" is now online.
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Today, mission 14: “Bridge to space” is now online. Sorry to keep you waiting.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission-14-preview][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Mission14Cover.png[/img][/url]

To support both offensive and defensive operation, UCN schedule to send its new secret prototype superweapon into space. The launch site is located in Eastern Siberia territory, rendering it in risk of being attacked by CFN surgical strike force. Spetsnaz 2nd Battalion was assigned to guard the launch operation and protect the shuttle until it successfully climb to safe altitude, higher than the height BattleFrames can intercept.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission-14-preview1][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/UDK_2016-01-26_21-07-54-07.png[/img][/url]

The continuous success of previous missions displays the top notch skill, teamwork and high level of trust in each other among Spetsnaz squadron. But can they hold out against the massive onslaught of the enemy?

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission-14-preview20][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/UDK_2016-01-27_09-14-13-05.png[/img][/url]

Hostile strike teams will stop at nothing. You'll be facing numerous warships and squadrons after squadrons of BattleFrames, while CFN transports carrying ground units throw themselves at the defense line to make sure SSTO never get out of Siberia.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission-14-preview6][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/UDK_2016-01-27_08-56-43-04.png[/img][/url]

There are 3 pilots (with one more exclusive to ‘PREPARE TO DIE’ difficulty) from KickStarter backers. One of them is an ace with his custom M3S. This might be the first time you will fight against an enemy with melee weapon.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission-14-preview27][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/UDK_2016-01-27_09-16-43-03.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission-14-preview11][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/UDK_2016-01-27_09-04-31-03.png[/img][/url]

Like in recent previous mission. You can play as both Yuliana in her ZX-05 Zavtra or Col. Andei in his red custom S-37 Terminator. The next mission is the last mission in Act II of the game so the next mission will be a very intense climax. You might consider Mission 14 as the calm before the storm.

Hope you guys enjoy the new content we added to the game!
-- GameCrafterTeam staffs.

notes.title: Minor update: Shimakaze Kai build
notes.content:

Thank you very much for your support.
Pawee Pakamekanon

Hello, we haven’t post new update for quite some time right? Today we have new mission for Project Nimbus: “Fall! Bird of peace!”.

Bird of peace? Well, in this mission your target is only one prototype weapon. This:

It’s the fastest superweapon yet, the High-Speed Orbital Attacker Unit!

[URL=http://s1086.photobucket.com/user/pawee30948/media/PN_HSOAU_screencap_2_zpsu0oy4fsl.png.html][IMG]http://i1086.photobucket.com/albums/j443/pawee30948/PN_HSOAU_screencap_2_zpsu0oy4fsl.png[/IMG][/URL]

As the war set its stages, CFN set the course of the joint-project superweapons towards key UCN’s military installations in the Russian mainland. It’s heading to Vladivostok base in eastern Siberia. “Krasnaya Kometa” squadron is scrambled to intercept.

[URL=http://s1086.photobucket.com/user/pawee30948/media/UDK%202015-12-01%2009-09-09-52_zps9rshkyuz.jpg.html][IMG]http://i1086.photobucket.com/albums/j443/pawee30948/UDK%202015-12-01%2009-09-09-52_zps9rshkyuz.jpg[/IMG][/URL]

Sortie as Lt. Yuliana Alexandrova in her nimble ZX-05 Zavtra, or Col.Andei Dmitriv in his powerful S37 Terminator to take down the weapon!

It is very fast. You have been warned. This is a high-speed aerial fight with non-stop barrage of beam weapons! Reflex is more important than ever!

notes.title: New campaign mission "Red Comet" is now available for play!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Today I'm proud and excited to announce to you guys that the new build of the game has just been uploaded. The new build's code name is "Shiratsuyu". Here's the list of what's just introduced in this update.

[img]https://scontent.fbkk5-1.fna.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpl1/t31.0-8/11952886_827769577340778_3240465294255885911_o.jpg[/img]
- New campaign mission is here! Mission 11 "Red Comet". This shall be one of, if not the hardest mission of the second episode of the game.
- You will play as one of the legendary ace pliot in Project Nimbus universe. You job is: sink entire attacking USAF fleet comprised of many capitol ships and a lot of escorting force. You'll have 5 minutes to sink most of enemy fleet before your allied fleet (which is much weaker) arrive. I think this will be a very challenging and fun mission.
- The bug that let the game move a little bit everytime the player click in the pause menu is fixed.
- This is a big news for some of you guys, it has been requested so many time: we have add remappable control to the game for both conventional control (Mouse + Keyboard) and Joypad control. At this moment, the remapper is only in main menu's option. We've not add it to pause menu's option yet and the tutorial text haven't change according to the remapped button yet. This is not hard to do but it will take some time implementing.
- Unfortunately, at this moment this new build is delivered to only PC. Because of the unexpected technical difficulty I just see on Mac OS (from the new remappable control system), the Mac OS build of the game is not uploaded yet. I think it shall take about 24 to 48 hours to fix this problem.
====

Tip for the "Red Comet" mission:
- The Particle Cannon is meant to be anti-ship weapon and it's much more powerful than other typer of weapon including Rail Gun. So I think it will be good idea that while you're waiting for the Particle Cannon to be reloaded, you just go empty your other type of ammunition on the escort force. When the Particle Cannon is ready, approach one of the capital ship and fire.
- USAF's combat ships are very agile. If you want to make sure that they won't be able to evade your Particle Cannon, get as close to the target as you can and use bullet time to assist when you're firing.
- It's possible to clear enemy's force even 1 minute before your allied fleet arrive.

notes.title: Tuned, Rebalanced, Optimized... new update is online!
notes.content:
Ok, what's new in 'Yudachi Kai' update?
- This is a minor update. There's no new content presented in this build.
- We've fix the crash occurred in Sacrificet Omnia mission... for sure this time.
- We've change bullet's missile interception algorithm, the performance shall be better now when there're lot of missiles and bullets flying in the battlefield.
- There's a lot of optimization here and there....
- Micromissiles get new particle system. It shall be prettier.
- We've tuned S47 Berkut's A.I. to make it as strong as it should be. This shall make it's easier for you to beat ace pilots in the second part of FOR THE FATHERLAND mission.
- Up until now, the Kirov class Destroyer's laser turret are bug and unable to hit anything. It's fixed now. That mean Kirov class Destroyer (and Russian Frigate) will be much more reliable allies and fearful enemy.
- The chat windows is disabled. Gone are the day that your frame paralyzed when you mistakenly press the T button.
- Even we've done lot of optimization work and it benefit all of the game's levels. That's not enough to make the FOR THE FATHERLAND mission have significant better performance. We adjust the scale of the battle down in that mission. If you're unable to play this mission due to major frame rate problem, please try again in this build and tell us how is it now.

notes.title: New mission! Mission 9: Thermopylae, you're going to fight in space this time!
notes.content:
Ok, the new build (code name: Shigure Kai Ni) is now online. Here's the list of what's new in this update.

- New campaign mission, mission 9: Thermopylae is now available for play. This time, you're a USAF pilot call sign Skull-1 piloting brand new transformable Battle Frame M5 Viper guarding Ecuador orbital elevator from well… a Kirov class destroyer, 2 St.Petersburg class corvette, about a hundred of fighter and Battle Frame.

- It’s 4 M5 (and 4 M3) against entire Spetsnaz strike force. And the Russian are very angry this time. Did I mention you that there are some S47 Berkut and Gripen in enemy’s strike force? Yes, today you’re dogfighting these powerful machines. So… good luck out there. Hope you survive the battle.

- You guys remember the Salustaris ship you fought somewhere in the first episode right? Imagine another ship in that class, with more modern weaponry and much, much more turret and armor. The Kirov class destroyer have ability to track and intercept multiple incoming missiles and target at once. Have fun taking it out with mass produced frame, not prototype one.

- We’ve implement M5 Viper A.I., in 9th mission, you’ll see them as your 3 wingmen. There’ll really stick with you and provide you, their squadron leader, cover. M5 Viper’s A.I. is by far, the most advance and sophisticate Battle Frame A.I. we’ve ever design.

- Yes, like the S47 and Gripen, expect to fight them as enemy in next missions.

- New ‘Battle Camera’ system that will zoom in to locked target and display the image in small window near the target’s position on your screen. With this system, you’ll be able to see your distance target. No more dogfighting fast moving green dots on the screen. Now you actually see your opponent every movement and destruction. You’re going to love this. :D

- We adjust Rise Mirai level’s level design a little bit to make it’s less likely for player to get stuck in Mirai’s starting up hangar. And we improve that scene’s lighting a little bit.

- This might be minor things for some of you guys, but all missions now have subtitle. So it shall be easier to understand what’s going on.

- Hope you guys enjoy this update! And… well, hope you guys survive the ‘Thermopylae’ mission.

notes.title: The game keep getting better right? New update: Fubuki Kai Ni, is now online!
notes.content:
The new update build, code name 'Fubuki Kai Ni' is now online. Here's the list of what we've done in this update.

- The multi-lock speed when using bullet time is now much faster, it's now possible to multi-lock all of Mirai's 30 micromissile in a single bullet time period.

- You gotta LOVE Berkut's new gun, it's like combination of assault rifle + grenade launcher + shotgun. S47 Berkut's gun now is a automatic fragmented 40mm grenade gun. That mean it fire 8 40mm grenade at once. It's a little bit similar to shotgun and is very deadly at close range.

- New homing algorithm for missile. Each individual missile fired now has individual track of its self. So if there're 100 missiles fired, there'll be 100 missiles track. So, well... It's much harder to be intercepted/dodge. This system applied to both yours and enemies's missiles. So be caution, missiles are becoming much more dangerous.

- You can now toggle Invert-Y control from the option screen.

- M5 Viper flight mode control now redesigned to be in the similar fashion to the Battle Frame mode. For most people, it's now much easier to pilot it.

- Gripen's missile precision/accuracy greatly improved.

- Each type of weapon now using different cross hair. So you can know what kind of weapon you're using without having to glance at the bottom right of the screen.

- A.I.'s AF-18 jet fighters are now faster and utilize better weaponry. They shall not be outperformed by drones now.

- Missile trail effect improved. Display glitch at the end of its trail removed. And it now look softer and bigger now.
